title: Other reports' filter bars keep today's behaviour
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales By Customer.
  2. Open its Customer filter.
  3. Open its Date filter.
  4. Pick Custom range.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The chips read as today, for example "Customer: All customers" and "Product Type: All products".

Step 2:

  • The Customer list opens as today, the cursor not put in its search box.

Step 3:

  • The Date list opens as today.

Step 4:

  • The custom range shows today's range hint (for example "Range: 31 days (max 366)").
